name: Haley
description: Sun-loving and image-conscious at first glance. Coconut, fruit salad, and patience reveal a softer side.

seo.title: Haley — Photographer
seo.description: Sun-loving and image-conscious at first glance. Coconut, fruit salad, and patience reveal a softer side.

stardew.intro: Emily's younger sister and an aspiring photographer. She can seem shallow until you notice how she cares behind the camera.

heartEvents.title: Lost bracelet
heartEvents.summary: Help her search the beach for a bracelet she lost in the sand.

heartEvents.title: Darkroom reveal
heartEvents.summary: She shows you her photography setup at home — a side no one else sees.

heartEvents.title: Cow rescue
heartEvents.summary: A cow is stuck in the fence; helping her frees it and earns real gratitude.

heartEvents.title: Fair cake
heartEvents.summary: At the Stardew Valley Fair she asks you to taste her entry and shares a sweet moment.

heartEvents.title: Darkroom kiss
heartEvents.summary: She develops photos of you together and kisses you in the darkroom.

relationships.name: Emily
relationships.note: Older sister and roommate — they bicker but clearly depend on each other.

relationships.name: Alex
relationships.note: Childhood friend; they still hang out around the square.

trivia: Coconut from the Desert or Ginger Island is an easy loved gift once you unlock travel.
